title: Across Accounts, Under Budget: TruvAI by TC2
abstract: What if AI could see across your AWS accounts, without burning your budget to do it? In this Community Day talk, TC2 shares how its AWS-based AI solution keeps agents practical in the real world: choosing models with cost in mind and reaching across accounts when the answer isn't in a single place. We'll connect that approach to everyday challenges and close with a live demo.
